router = APIRouter(prefix="/finance/ledgers")

@router.post("/{ledger_id}/stream-import")
async def stream_ledger_csv(
    ledger_id: str,
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    ledger_repo: LedgerRepository = Depends(get_ledger_repo),
    user: AuthUser = Depends(get_auth_user)
):
    ledger = await ledger_repo.find_ledger(ledger_id)
    if not ledger:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Ledger not found")

    buffer = ""
    imported_rows = 0
    while chunk := await file.read(131072):
        buffer += chunk.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        lines = buffer.split("\n")

        reader = csv.DictReader(lines)
        for row in reader:
            await ledger_repo.insert_transaction(ledger_id, row)
            imported_rows += 1

corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, UploadFile, File, Depends, HTTPException
import csv
import io

router = APIRouter(prefix="/finance/ledgers")

@router.post("/{ledger_id}/stream-import")
async def stream_ledger_csv(
    ledger_id: str,
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    ledger_repo: LedgerRepository = Depends(get_ledger_repo),
    user: AuthUser = Depends(get_auth_user)
):
    ledger = await ledger_repo.find_ledger(ledger_id)
    if not ledger:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Ledger not found")
    if ledger.company_id != user.company_id and not user.is_auditor:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: user lacks access to this general ledger")

    buffer = ""
    imported_rows = 0
    while chunk := await file.read(131072):
        buffer += chunk.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        lines = buffer.split("\n")
        buffer = lines.pop()
        
        reader = csv.DictReader(lines)
        for row in reader:
            await ledger_repo.insert_transaction(ledger_id, row)
            imported_rows += 1

    return {"ledger_id": ledger_id, "imported_transactions": imported_rows}
